jobs.title: Practice Lead, Finance and Investment (Build and Scale a New Practice)
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Practice Lead" role requiring extensive experience building and scaling a finance/investment practice — well beyond the candidate's MSc-stage profile. Field (finance/investment advisory) is also outside the candidate's IR/policy and intelligence targets. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff, Global Partnerships
jobs.reason: This is a senior GTM/commercial Chief of Staff role requiring 7+ years of experience including prior Chief of Staff or management consulting tenure supporting C-suite leaders — a hard ineligibility on seniority. The field (cloud/AI commercial partnerships) is also outside the candidate's policy/research target zones, and the role requires specific knowledge of hyperscaler/SI/ISV ecosystems the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Migrant Futures Institute Events & Communications Coordinator
jobs.reason: Migration research and policy at a university institute is adjacent to the candidate's interests in post-atrocity politics, displacement, and critical IR, though this is an events/communications coordinator role rather than a research post. The candidate has relevant administrative and stakeholder-coordination experience from the German Rectors Conference, but lacks dedicated events/comms experience. Seniority and pay band fit a junior coordinator role reasonably well.

jobs.title: Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an administrative/operations coordination role focused on scheduling, invoicing, and vendor management in Southeast Asia — unrelated to IR, policy research, intelligence, or OSINT. While the ESG context is mildly policy-adjacent, the actual work is logistical client-service coordination with no research component.

jobs.title: Global Strategy and Operations Manager
jobs.reason: This is an internal operations/chief-of-staff role at a consulting firm rather than a research or policy analyst role — it sits outside the candidate's three target zones (policy research, geopolitical risk analysis, hybrid OSINT/research-engineer). It also asks for 3-5 years of strategy consulting or cross-functional ops experience, which the candidate (still completing MSc, with student-assistant roles only) does not have.

jobs.title: Senior Burkina Faso Country Researcher
jobs.reason: CIR open-source investigations is a core target zone, but the "Senior" title and country-specialist framing indicate substantial regional expertise and years of experience the candidate lacks. Burkina Faso country research also almost certainly requires French fluency well beyond the candidate's B1 level, and likely deep Sahel/West Africa specialism — hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Training Specialist Afghanistan
jobs.reason: CIR is a core target organisation for OSINT/digital investigations work, but this specific role is an Afghanistan specialist training position that almost certainly requires regional expertise, likely Dari/Pashto language skills, and prior training-delivery experience the candidate lacks. The specialist framing and training-delivery focus do not align with the candidate's profile despite the strong organisational fit.

jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: Reprieve's human rights and strategic litigation work is highly relevant to the candidate's interests in international law and atrocity prevention, but this is a Manager-level role requiring substantial litigation/team leadership experience the candidate lacks. Hard ineligibility on seniority.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Studentische Hilfskraft (d/m/w) für das Forschungscluster »Klima- und Energiepolitik«
jobs.reason: SWP is a top-tier German foreign and security policy think-tank — strong institutional fit — but climate and energy policy sits outside the candidate's core interests (international law, security, atrocity prevention). Skills (German native, research, literature review, Office) match cleanly and the student-assistant level is exactly right.

jobs.title: Legal Advisor
jobs.reason: This role requires a qualified legal practitioner to provide employment law advice and commercial contract drafting — the candidate does not hold a UK qualifying law degree, GDL, or SQE, triggering hard ineligibility. The Grade 8 salary and remit also imply significant post-qualification experience that the candidate lacks.
